title: Disclaimer I guess, it’s possible that I’ll feel a bit differently af...
transcript: I literally just got home from the very first preview of the Alicia Keys musical. I have some reservations, but it's good. First of all, I would not call this a bio jukebox musical in a traditional sense. It's loosely about her, but it's a coming of age story. It's her at age seventeen, dealing with her complicated relationships with her parents, with a guy, all while discovering her passion for playing piano. Scores. Primarily pre existing Alicia Keys songs, but she also did write a couple of original songs for it. Probably my biggest issue with the show in its current state, which is, again, keep in mind, after the very first performance ever. Biggest issue at this point is also kind of a backhanded compliment, which is that the songs hit so hard, every single one is such a rich, passionate, emotional catharsis that there's maybe not enough space for each one to be adequately set up and feel totally earned. Maybe a bit of missing the forest for the trees right now, but I definitely think it could be improved. But in my opinion, they already have the two most important things they need going forward, which is a the emotional backbone is there. At its core, this is a beautiful coming of age story about trying to appreciate the people you have while you have them. Secondly, they have the spirit. The show is electric, it's alive and dynamic. Obviously the songs are amazing, but also The choreography, Camille A. Brown works for magic as usual. Whole cast freaking kills it, but especially Malia Joy Moon in the lead role is absolutely a star making performance for them. They are so charismatic and expressive, but also very grounded and connected to the text. Even when something in the script was maybe a little cliche or a little contrived, they still completely sell it. So yeah, overall, I was impressed with the show. And I had some issues with it, like I said, some of which I didn't even get into because, again, it was the first preview. And also, I think they are well positioned to do the work that they need to do to get this to where it needs to be. And I would definitely be rooting for this to have a future life.
reasoning: Clear recommendation with notable caveats about pacing/song setup, but praises emotional core, cast, choreography, and is rooting for its future. First preview context noted.
keyQuote: Overall, I was impressed with the show... I would definitely be rooting for this to have a future life.
